BiblicalUsage: Lentils — adash is the humble food that shows up at the hinges of great stories. Jacob gave Esau "bread and pottage of lentiles" for his birthright; lentils were brought to feed David's fugitives; Shammah stood his ground in "a piece of ground full of lentiles" while the army fled; and Ezekiel was told to take lentils for his bread in the siege.
TheologicalSignificance: Lentils are humble food, and the stories they sit in — a birthright sold for pottage, a hero's stand in a lentil field — carry the warning.
